summary: Reject reserved flags in MP4 movie/media time headers
before: Both wrappers accept nonzero reserved FullBox flags in mvhd/mdhd v0/v1. The original forced refusal test reports all eight low/high-bit companions accepted; zero-flag v0/v1 controls pass exact clocks, packet bytes and packet-budget checks. Original result: 1 passed, 1 failed.
after: Validate reserved flags in shared media_time before consuming time fields, preserving version checks and the specific invalid-input error. Core: 2 focused plus 5 related tests pass. Player: 4 focused plus 12 related tests pass, distinguishing malformed-input refusal before decoding from successful v0/v1 native RGB playback, 60ms duration, seek, rewind and repeated EOF. No failures or ignored tests.
tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --features player --test mp4_time_header_flags --test mp4_unknown_duration --test mp4_tfhd_defaults --test mp4_hybrid_fragments
results: 7 core and 16 player tests passed; 0 failed/ignored.
independence: One missing FullBox flag check in the shared time-header parser. Header/version/bit variants and tests count once.
